message:
You know, I’ve always prided myself on being the gloriously over-prepared one in the family. When the skies turn gray and the wind starts to pick up, I’ve got my trusty emergency kit ready to go, complete with snacks and a crossword puzzle. It’s amazing how a little planning can make you feel like you’ve got things under control, even when Mother Nature gets a bit rowdy. 

I found a helpful resource that outlines what to do before, during, and after a storm, which is perfect for those who might not be as ready as I am. Remember, a little preparation goes a long way. What are your go-to tips for staying calm during a storm? 🌪️
